beats: Every lesson check and playlist leaned on three outside services — if one broke, a lesson stalled mid-word, and a gap let some requests skip payment entirely.
Now one VPS we control does the whole job.
Like closing every back door to a shop, so every sale has to pass the till.
Three fragile dependencies became one steady process, billing only on our own server.
The payoff: roughly eighteen hundred lines of fragile code, deleted for good.
